sn22.22:2.2: Note that the Jain meaning is “mass”, “matter”, while the sense “mass” is also found in Arthaśastra 2.14.7, 2.14.43 (of gold). The etymology is unclear, but it is a primarily Buddhist and Jain term, being absent from pre-Buddhist texts.
sn22.22:3.2: As usual, I prefer to translate tatra tatra and related idioms as distributive.
